newsitem.title: FINLAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort has M-Serla sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Kleinwort has M-Serla sell.

text.p: Dresdner Kleinwort Benson recommends "sell" for Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy in its Pulp, Paper & Packaging Update research dated February 20.

"Several stocks, which are highly geared to a recovery in pulp and fine paper prices such as MoDo, Metsa-Serla and Ence, have now risen to a level at which they look fully valued, particularly in view of further pulp price weakness ahead," Kleinwort said.
"The current rally offers a good selling opportunity," it said.
At 1210/1010 GMT, Metsa-Serla's B share traded at 42.50 markka, down 0.50 markka. The share has risen 18 percent since the group released its 1996 earnings on February 10.
